data.gender_notes: Roderick is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Roderick is derived from the Germanic words 'hroth' meaning 'fame' and 'ric' meaning 'ruler'. In Christian tradition, it symbolizes a leader who is renowned for their wisdom and courage. The name Roderick carries the meaning “Famous Ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in Germanic, English. Parents who choose Roderick usually hope their child will grow to embody famous ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Roderick represents a strong and fair leader who guides others with wisdom and compassion.
data.etymology: Roderick belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Famous Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roderick total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: רודריק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: רודריק הוא שם שמקורו בגרמנית, מורכב משני חלקים: 'רוד' - מנהיג, ו'ריק' - עם גדול, ומשמעותו היא מנהיג העם הגדול, אין קשר ישיר למקורות עבריים או ביבליים

in_greek.name: Ροδερίκος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ροδερίκος προέρχεται από τη γερμανική, αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'Ροδ' - ηγεμόνας, και 'ερίκος' - μέγας λαός, και σημαίνει ηγεμόνας του μεγάλου λαού, δεν υπάρχει άμεσος σύνδεσμος με ελληνικές ή βιβλικές ρίζες

in_latin.name: Rodericus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Rodericus originem habet in Germanica, constat duobus partibus: 'Rod' - dux, et 'eric' - populus magnus, significans dux populi magni, nullum directum connexum cum fontibus Latinis aut Biblicis

in_english.name: Roderick
in_english.long_meaning: Roderick is a name of Germanic origin, composed of two parts: 'Rod' - leader, and 'erick' - great people, meaning leader of the great people, with no direct connection to Hebrew or Biblical roots but significant in Christian tradition
